selection: validation q100 masked MAE in original kWh/15min
loss: q100 masked MAE in original units; inverse scaling inside objective
inputs: existing seven event-time/calendar channels; no lagged measured targets
sensitivity_policy: evaluate frozen predictions under masks; do not retrain or select with sensitivity masks
test_policy: separate explicit export only after all checkpoints selected; immutable per-key files; later independent checks reuse saved predictions
smoke_policy: train/validation only; two batches and one epoch; test loader disabled
open_items: verify architecture identities and parameter matching before freezing
review batch/loss/normalization semantics and CPU smoke checks
register frozen experiment and bind source/environment hashes before GPU launch
